speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Boy. Aldermanbury. Master Heminges, and no other door. Four lines. You will say them back before you go.

speaker: (the errand-boy)
text: Tuesday. Canon Row. By water at five. The king, whole.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: That is the four. You will not add a name. You will not add a why. If he asks whose guest, you were not told.

speaker: (the errand-boy)
text: I was not told. I can say that. I will not make a fifth to be helpful.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Come back when it is said. I will know by his answer, not by a story you add.

speaker: (the errand-boy)
text: Aldermanbury. Master Heminges. Four lines. No name. I have them.
